verifications.claim: Marry or Move On is a Netflix reality series.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On" is coming to the streaming service... new dating show"; "Season 2 of the Netflix series"; "The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On... Netflix reality dating shows"; "The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On... Reality TV"
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly identify 'The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On' as a Netflix reality/dating series.

verifications.claim: Marry or Move On first aired 2022.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Netflix will drop the first eight episodes... on April 6... (context post-Love Is Blind S2 reunion in 2022)"; "The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On (TV Series 2022– )"; "2024 3 Seasons"
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm premiere in April 2022 via announcement timing and series dating.

verifications.claim: Marry or Move On include Queer Love.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: 'The Ultimatum: Queer Love' Trailer... (separate series)"; "second season — with an all-queer, mostly female cast" (referring to spin-off, not inclusion in main series)
verifications.reasoning: Queer Love is presented as a distinct spin-off series, not included within the main 'Marry or Move On' series.

verifications.claim: Marry or Move On are hosted by Nick and Vanessa Lachey.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Love Is Blind” hosts Nick and Vanessa Lachey guide the couples"; "co-hosted by Nick and Vanessa Lachey"; "Starring: Nick Lachey, Vanessa Lachey"; "hosts Vanessa and Nick Lachey"
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated across multiple sources that Nick and Vanessa Lachey host the series.

verifications.claim: There are 3 seasons of The Ultimatum available to stream on Netflix.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The Ultimatum Season 3"; "2024 3 Seasons⁨TV-MA⁩Reality TV... available to stream on Netflix"
verifications.reasoning: Netflix page and Season 3 article confirm 3 seasons available.

verifications.claim: The Ultimatum series is available exclusively on Netflix.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "coming to the streaming service"; "now streaming in full on Netflix"; "available to stream on Netflix"; "Watch The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On | Netflix Official Site"
verifications.reasoning: All sources position it exclusively on Netflix with no mention of other platforms.

verifications.claim: In The Ultimatum Netflix series, one partner is ready for marriage while the other is not.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "one partner appears to be ready to walk down the aisle, the other isn't"; "couples in which one partner is ready to get married, but the other one isn’t"; "one person's ready to get hitched and the other…isn’t"
verifications.reasoning: Core premise directly stated in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: In The Ultimatum Netflix series, the hesitant partner is given an ultimatum: marry or move on.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On"; "Lisa, who issued the ultimatum"; "Ryann gave James the ultimatum"
verifications.reasoning: Series title and descriptions explicitly describe the ultimatum as 'marry or move on' given to the hesitant partner.

verifications.claim: In The Ultimatum Netflix series, couples separate, date other people, and shack up with a new potential match for three weeks to test their love before deciding on their original relationship.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "choosing a new potential partner... eight-week process"; "date other people... “trial marriage” with a new partner. That trial marriage lasts three weeks"; "select another person to live with for three weeks... reunite with their original partner"
verifications.reasoning: Process matches exactly: separation, dating/trial with new partner for 3 weeks, then original, before decision.

verifications.claim: An ultimatum is a final demand or proposal, the rejection of which will result in the end of negotiations or a relationship.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "a final proposition, condition, or demand especially : one whose rejection will end negotiations"; "a demand whose fulfillment is requested... backed up by a threat... final demand in a series of requests"
verifications.reasoning: Definition directly matches, with examples extending to relationships.

verifications.claim: An ultimatum is often a short-term deadline set to compel a specific action, usually backed by a threat of consequences if complied with.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "one whose rejection will end negotiations"; "threat to be followed through in case of noncompliance (open loop)"; "specified period of time... noncompliance"
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify threat for noncompliance, not compliance; claim reverses this key element.

verifications.claim: The Ultimatum Game is a game theory experiment where one player (proposer) divides a sum of money and proposes a split.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The ultimatum game is a popular experimental economics game... The first player, the proposer, proposes a division of the sum with the second player"
verifications.reasoning: Exact description of proposer dividing and proposing split.

verifications.claim: In the Ultimatum Game, the second player (responder) can accept (both get money) or reject (neither gets money) the offer.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The responder can either accept the proposed division or reject it. If the responder accepts, the money is split according to the proposal; if the responder rejects, neither player receives anything."
